name: source-bundle-path-rules-v1

path_semantics.archive_root: Every archive must contain exactly one non-empty top-level directory. Strip that directory before selection.
path_semantics.encoding: Every relative path must round-trip through strict UTF-8 without normalization.
path_semantics.separator: Only POSIX slash separators are accepted; backslashes are rejected.
path_semantics.matching: Extension, segment, and prefix comparisons are case-sensitive. Case-fold collisions are rejected before selection.

claim_ceiling: Frozen development-corpus selection rules only; no acquired byte, benchmark result, validation result, or performance claim.
